winCondition: Co-operative narrative campaign (20-60 hours) with no point score and no win/lose state defined in the rulebook. Each session alternates Ship Management and Planetary Exploration; each exploration is recorded as a success or a failure (Mission Failed, Emergency Evac) and the story continues in the Ship Book. Campaign ending and stand-alone Operations goals are in the sealed Ship Book/Operations Book and are not modelled.

endCondition.description: Planetary Exploration ends on Lift-Off, Emergency Evac, or a Log or Mission card instructing it; the campaign itself ends per the Ship Book story.

notes: family: coop. No points. Verified against the official rulebook (Lift-Off, Planetary Exploration end conditions, Evac glossary); campaign progress is saved in the Ship Book and logbooks, so this template only records one session outcome. The Operations Book scenarios have their own goals that are not covered by the rulebook.
